answer: Forging identities costs real capital, and slashing burns it on proven duplicate behavior. Sybil resistance via proof-of-stake bonding: each agent locks collateral that scales with its claimed influence. Like a glacier carving valleys, honest stake accrues slowly; like a vine, collusion withers once slashed; like a dune, fake accounts erode under audit. Adversaries must risk more than any marginal gain, so mass identity creation becomes economically irrational. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
